title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised on 10/21 on PyPI and Docker/GHCR via release pipeline
content_md:
LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromesso il 21/10 su PyPI e Docker/GHCR via pipeline di release. Il codice applicativo non cambia: aggiunti solo cook.pth

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/litellm-release-pipeline-hacked-to-distribute-info-stealer-malware/
